{{velocity}} ## --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Administration tools of the current wiki, included in the "Advanced ## Bookmarks" administration section: availability of the storage, export and ## import of the bookmarks of all the users (advancedbookmarks/admintools.js). ## Only displayed to the administrators of the wiki; the service checks the ## rights again for each operation. ## --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #set ($wikiReference = $services.model.createWikiReference($services.wiki.currentWikiId)) #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('admin', $wikiReference)) #if ($services.advancedbookmarks.admin) #set ($storeStatus = $services.advancedbookmarks.admin.getStoreStatus()) #end === {{translation key="advancedbookmarks.admin.tools.storeHeading"/}} === #if ($storeStatus.available) {{success}}{{translation key="advancedbookmarks.admin.tools.storeAvailable"/}}{{/success}} #else {{error}}{{translation key="advancedbookmarks.admin.tools.storeUnavailable"/}}{{/error}} #end === {{translation key="advancedbookmarks.admin.tools.transferHeading"/}} === {{translation key="advancedbookmarks.admin.tools.transferHelp"/}} ## The shared helpers must be loaded before the script that requires them. #set ($discard = $xwiki.jsrx.use('advancedbookmarks/common.js')) #set ($discard = $xwiki.jsrx.use('advancedbookmarks/admintools.js')) {{html}}
{{/html}} #end {{/velocity}}
